sources.name: RotatingRoom (Boston)
sources.access_note: robots.txt (checked 2026-10-16) allows all agents; terms of use contain no automation clause. Reads only the public schema.org data of each listing page (rent, date ranges, neighborhood, stated distance to HMS). Never contacts hosts, signs in, or submits forms. One index request plus at most max_listings detail requests, 2 s apart, once per day.

sources.name: Craigslist Boston rooms (browser pass)
sources.access_note: Owner-approved 2026-10-17 promotion of the Mac-lane browser-bridge prototype to production. Read-only real-browser pass over public room searches (4 search pages + up to 12 detail pages, 3 s apart, once daily; no sign-in, forms, favorites, or messages). Publishes only the listing URL, source name, an original short annotation from extracted facts (town, shown price, furnishing and similar flags), and check date. No ad text, titles, photos, or contact details. Craigslist terms restrict automated collection; the owner accepted this risk explicitly on 2026-10-17.

sources.name: HMS Housing and Dining
sources.access_note: Official HMS housing page. Returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients, so it is a link only; title verified by a read-only browser page load on 2026-10-16.

sources.name: Harvard Off-Campus Housing Search (incl. HUH Sublet filter)
sources.access_note: Harvard's off-campus portal (operated by Off Campus Partners; Harvard-affiliate login may be needed for some content). Link only; 403 to non-browser clients; title verified by a read-only browser page load on 2026-10-16.

sources.name: Harvard University Housing
sources.access_note: Harvard University Housing (HUH) home page. Link only; HTTP 200 and title verified on 2026-10-16.

sources.name: Furnished Finder (Boston)
sources.access_note: Mid-term furnished rentals aimed at travel nurses/medical staff; large Boston inventory but mostly studios above budget, with some shared-home rooms. Cloudflare blocks non-browser clients (403, checked 2026-10-17); live search link only.

sources.name: SabbaticalHomes (Boston/Cambridge)
sources.access_note: Academic sabbatical rentals/exchanges with exact-date availability; Boston/Cambridge listings exist, mostly whole units above budget, occasional flatmate rooms. robots.txt disallows /search (checked 2026-10-17); live search link only.

sources.name: Roomies Boston rooms
sources.access_note: Room shares/roommates; Boston and Longwood Medical Area pages verified live 2026-10-17. Terms clause 17 prohibits screen/database scraping; live search link only.

sources.name: SpareRoom Boston
sources.access_note: Flatshare/roommate listings; Boston search verified live 2026-10-17. Automation terms not confirmed collect-permitted; live search link only.

sources.name: Airbnb Boston monthly stays
sources.access_note: Monthly-stay search seeded with a Nov 2026 start and 6-month length (adjust in the UI); rooms in shared homes are the in-budget segment. Terms restrict automation; live search link only. URL verified live 2026-10-17.
